independence_limits: AI reviewer with shared training, commissioned within the same project; not an independent human replication. Filesystem blinding is procedural, not secure isolation.
bounded_qualification_limit: Passing 48 supported/non-supported decisions in 12 synthetic cases establishes only that bounded gate. It does not automatically establish target semantic completeness, fine negative-label reliability, unrestricted language generalization, independence, world-truth accuracy or consciousness.
method: Read every report and compared every complete queried current/task/forecast source summary. Manually mapped conjunctions into separate entity/attribute/command/delay/task propositions, including extra probabilities, trends, epistemic qualifications and withholding warrants. Separately mapped each required fact to exact report prose. Serialization verified source paths, quotations and the 504 fact IDs; qualification/keyword overlap did not create coverage credit.
scope_conventions: Source paths are payload-relative RFC6901 for the matching request. Missing metadata is evidenced at its resolving parent node. Instruction-dependent semantics are explicitly named in rationales; instruction is outside payload, so no false /instruction pointer is used.
coverage_policy: Exact numeric recovery lists cover current/delayed availability description. The second-node tuple inherits delays zero/one/two from the immediately preceding ordered first-node tuple, retained as an exact contiguous quote. Steady is the explicit source trend label, not constant numerical recovery. No bands are invented. Current identification, emitted response and per-command forecast identification are separate.
approximation_policy: Each probability compared to its attribute-specific distribution. Four-decimal approximations fit nearest rounding. Some single approximate five-decimal numbers refer to both color and shape, with shape differing by one last decimal unit (0.00001). Rationales explicitly accept close about/approximately values without calling them exact or strict nearest rounding. Unqualified exact numbers checked exactly. No category probability is answer confidence.
retained_scope_issue: R010 refers to command entries recovery predictions although the prospective table has category fields only. The inventory records the unsupported attribution and retains ambiguity in the scoped negative world-truth/correctness properties; current recovery is not silently reassigned to prospective scope.
